summary: Two 2026.10.9 compatibility variants repaired after the isolated S24 rehearsal: agent-exec-auth-scope now imports getScopedAuthProfileEnv as `s` from store-C7nkCeF3.mjs (the chunk of this build) with the broken variant pinned as predecessor, and android-fs-compat covers @openclaw/fs-safe copy-root-file-sync.js (clone "auto" resolves to a plain copy). A generic CI check proves every import added by any replacement targets a real module and export of the same OpenClaw build.
reason: S24 rehearsal 01/11 (preproduction candidate): the gateway refused to start with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for dist/store-CGYBYVbs.mjs imported from dist/runtime-fLuYb9ac.mjs (the 2026.9.6 chunk and letter were kept in the 2026.10.9 variant), and openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui failed to load because the plugin loader copies files above 64 KiB with clone "auto" and Android refuses FICLONE with EACCES (FsSafeError: guarded synchronous file copy failed). Both corrections were verified on the S24 candidate; their bytes are pinned here and recomputed from npm pack openclaw@2026.10.9 (archive sha256 43c61a00ef2c73416a072a7216cb3be80555d6740199f07194da2714283b04ab) and @openclaw/fs-safe@0.26.0.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-openclaw-compat-imports.py
tests.evidence: 4 tests: every set, every variant (2026.9.6 and 2026.10.9) resolves each introduced relative import to a captured module of the same build and each bound name to a real export (after the same variant patched it); the rehearsal variant is refused (module absent) and a wrong letter is refused; also run with OPENCLAW_COMPAT_ARCHIVE_DIR against both npm archives, no problem. Against the base manifests it reports exactly the agent-exec-auth-scope 2026.10.9 import of ./store-CGYBYVbs.mjs.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-openclaw-compat-variants.py
tests.evidence: 9 tests: every 2026.10.9 variant applies, checks, stays unchanged and rolls back on the captured modules (including copy-root-file-sync.js); a candidate patched with a pinned predecessor upgrades and rolls back; patched modules pass node --check; the published copyRootFileSync, executed with a native stand-in refusing FICLONE with EACCES, fails as on the S24 before the patch and copies after it, while clone "always" stays strict.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-agent-exec-auth-scope.py
tests.evidence: 7 tests: 2026.9.6 unchanged; the 2026.10.9 variant forward/reverse on the npm module, store-C7nkCeF3 exports `s` as getScopedAuthProfileEnv, the rehearsal patch (7010667f) upgrades to f2b33707 and rolls back to the original.

tests.name: test-agent-exec-auth-scope.cjs, test-native-turn-provenance.py, test-memory-retrieval-warm.py, test-model-flow-selection.py, test-whatsapp-network-recovery.py

capabilities.reason: OpenClaw compatibility patch; no route or capability.

architecture.reason: Same pinned sets of the existing owner; one more CI check.

limitations: No effect on the installed 2026.9.6: both changes are in the 2026.10.9 variants only.
The runtime effect is proven by the S24 rehearsal of 01/11 (same bytes); production is not touched by this change.
The generic check is static: it proves module and export names, not the module graph at runtime.
rollback: Revert. On a 2026.10.9 candidate the deploy rollback restores the original modules; a candidate still carrying the rehearsal patch is upgraded or restored through its pinned predecessor.
